French, German, and Spanish test fixtures are reduced subsets of sentence packs from
[OHF-Voice/intents 2025.6.23](https://github.com/OHF-Voice/intents/tree/2025.6.23),
licensed under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
They retain the language rules and selected intent tables; other intents,
responses, comments, and formatting have been removed.
